marketing.footerTagline: One line about what your product does and who it is for.
marketing.promoBody: Your personal coach, without a coach
marketing.heroSubhead: Track your nutrition, training and body evolution. Everything personalised to you.
marketing.review1: I gained 8 kg of muscle in 6 months. The personalised programme made all the difference.
marketing.review2: The nutrition tracking changed everything. I lost 12 kg without ever feeling deprived.
marketing.researchHeading: One app to reach your physique goals.
marketing.researchBody: No coach, no gym membership required. Set your goal, follow your programme, and see the results.
marketing.stat1Body: Active members tracking their fitness journey every day, for every goal.
marketing.stat2Body: Rated by members for the quality and accuracy of personalised programmes.
marketing.stat3Body: Members who reach their physique goal within 6 months of consistent use.
marketing.howItWorksHeading: Four reasons people reach their goal.
marketing.howBody: The app adapts to your body, your schedule and your goal — not the other way around.
marketing.howItWorksStep1Body: Your measurements, goal and sport level shape a programme built specifically for you — no generic plan.
marketing.howItWorksStep2Body: Log meals in seconds and see exactly how your food matches your caloric and macro targets in real time.
marketing.howItWorksStep3Body: Programmes automatically adjust as you get stronger so you're always working at the right intensity.
marketing.howStep4Body: Track measurements, photos and performance over time to see how your body changes week by week.
marketing.threeStepHeading: From sign-up to your first programme in three steps.
marketing.processBody: No setup call, no complicated onboarding. Create your account and go.
marketing.threeStepStep1Body: Sign up with an email code, Google or a password. Takes under a minute.
marketing.threeStepStep2Body: Enter your measurements, goal and sport level so the app can personalise your plan.
marketing.threeStepStep3Body: Follow your personalised training and nutrition plan from day one.
marketing.trustGridHeading: Everything you need to transform your body.
marketing.controlBody: Track, plan and progress with the tools that make a real difference.
marketing.trustGrid1Body: Calculate your caloric needs and log every meal. See your macros at a glance.
marketing.trustGrid2Body: Programmes built around your goal, level and sessions per week — updated as you progress.
marketing.trustGrid3Body: Track weight, waist, hips and more over time to see your real progress beyond the scale.
marketing.trustGrid4Body: Your health data is yours. Stored securely and never shared with third parties.
marketing.control5Body: Use on your phone or desktop — your progress syncs automatically across devices.
marketing.control6Body: Compare side-by-side photos to see the transformation over weeks and months.
marketing.founderQuoteText: We built this because getting fit shouldn't require an expensive coach or a complicated app. Everyone deserves a plan that actually works for their body.
marketing.faq1Answer: Anyone who wants to improve their physique — whether your goal is muscle gain, fat loss, weight maintenance or body recomposition. All genders and all levels welcome.
marketing.faq2Answer: Not necessarily. You set your available equipment in your profile, and the app adapts your training programme accordingly.
marketing.faq3Answer: Your programme is based on your sex, age, measurements, sport level, goal and sessions per week. You can update all of these any time in your profile settings.
marketing.faq4Question: Can I update my measurements later?
marketing.faq4Answer: Yes. Update your weight, waist and other measurements at any time from your profile settings to keep your programme accurate.
marketing.faq5Answer: Your data is stored securely and never shared with third parties. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time.
marketing.faq6Answer: Use the help page to contact our team. We reply within one business day.
marketing.finalCtaSubhead: Create your account in 2 minutes and get your personalised training and nutrition plan today.
marketing.metaTitle: FitTrack — Your personal coach, without a coach
marketing.metaDescription: Track your nutrition, training and body measurements. Get a personalised programme based on your goal and sport level.
